steps.code:
# Fetch all sent transactions for this month.
access_token = login_result["access_token"]
all_sent_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction="sent",
        min_created_at="2023-05-01",
        max_created_at="2023-05-18",
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if isinstance(page, dict) and "message" in page:
        print("Error:", page)
        break
    all_sent_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total sent transactions: {len(all_sent_transactions)}")
for t in all_sent_transactions:
    print(t)
